correctness.rationale: Weakened bounded claim is correct as stated with clean proof/citation/open-remainder separation. (a) S: 196 values verified independently; only p with p^6<=10000200 are 2,3,5,7,11,13 (17^6=24137569>max), trial division yields exactly 4 exclusions 10000064,10000128,10000192 (64|k) and 10000165 (117649|k, 117649*85); re-ran enumeration, matches S.csv. (b) No squares/cubes: 3162^2=9998244<1e7<10000200<10004569=3163^2 and 215^3=9938375<1e7<10000200<10077696=216^3, plus per-k isqrt/binary-cbrt recheck passes. (c) Torsion: cited Fueter/Mazur lemma for y^2=x^3+k (k>0 sixth-power-free, k!=1) that torsion is Z/3 iff square, Z/2 iff cube, else trivial is standard and correctly applied; premise (sixth-power-free + no square/cube) verified. Self-contained Lutz for 186 minimal curves verified: Delta=-432k^2=-2^4*3^3*k^2, vp(Delta)<12 iff v2<=3 and v3<=4 (for p>=5, 2vp(k)<=10), Nagell-Lutz y=0 or y^2|Delta, and y^2|Delta iff y|12k proved via valuations (e.g. p=3: 2e<=3+2t => e<=1+t); divisor enumeration of 12k yields zero candidates (lutz.csv rechecked, spot re-enumeration with pure binary cube test gives zero; y=0 case is cube condition already excluded). 10 valuation-exceptional curves [10000016,10000032,10000048,10000080,10000096,10000112,10000144,10000160,10000176 (v2>=4),10000179 (v3=5)] correctly identified and explicitly marked as resting on cited classification, not overclaimed. (d) Bounded completeness for B=1e6, XMIN=-1000 proved: XMIN^3+max(S)=-989999800<0 plus monotonicity of x^3 covers all x<=B with x^3+k>=0; loop x=XMIN..B with math.isqrt exact test is exhaustive by construction. verify.py passes (S, 29 x-values/58 affine points substitution, square/cube, Hall max, XMIN). Independent full rerun (196 curves x 1,001,001 isqrt, 35.8s) reproduces points.json exactly with 0 mismatches; all 29 pairs satisfy y*y==x^3+k and lie in [XMIN,B]; per-curve lists match DRAFT Sec.2(c) and bounded_summary.csv (23/196 nonempty). (e) Rank>=1 for 23 curves follows from trivial torsion + one affine rational point of infinite order; only 10000144 among them is valuation-exceptional (uses cited torsion), other 22 use self-contained Lutz, as claimed. (f) Hall maximizer among found nonzero-x points is (10000079,153793,60312156) by exact integer comparison |x1|k2^2>|x2|k1^2 (no floats); independently recomputed best, R^2=153793/10000079^2=1.5379057010e-09, R=3.9216140822e-05 matching quoted 1.5379057e-9/3.9216141e-5; second-best (10000047,14893) gap is 13890121034726781524 in cross-product, unique; largest |x| coincides. heights.csv/hall.csv ordering verified exact, naive logs match natural log to 1e-9. Limitations (no Siegel completeness beyond B, no rank upper bounds/generators, no David/LLL sieve, no Cremona heights/regulators, local-modular search failure) are explicitly stated; no CAS claim. No essential inference, boundary, or computation error found.

originality.rationale: Achieved bounded claim is substantively new in the narrow sense of no overlap/duplicate, though method is elementary. Nearest prior Bennett-Ghadermarzi (arXiv:1311.7077, LMS J.Comput.Math.2015) solves Y^2=X^3+k for |k|<=1e7 via Thue equations; audit block (1e7,1e7+200] is strictly disjoint, so no per-k list is duplicated; method differs (exhaustive isqrt loop vs Thue/elliptic-log) and artifact differs (substitution lists + naive Hall table vs counts without height tables). Other cited priors give methods/bounds not censuses for this block: Gebel-Petho-Zimmer-Herrmann S-integral sieve, Ghadermarzi at-most-three-multiples bound, Pasten |k|^{1/2+eps} uniform bound, D'Mello Hall-gap lower bounds; none publishes L_k, saturated generators, or height extremum for these 196 k. Internal SCOPE memories are disjoint: 8 Resultary findings (Heilbronn, Kronecker, RSBF, nonnegative-rank, J2-free rank, synchronizing automata, 1-forbidden families, spider-walk mixing) and 18 failures (prime sextuplets, Littlewood, Henon, A(16,6,7), Ramsey-Turan, SmallGroups, BH, balls-in-bins, Szemeredi-Trotter, Z_197 bases, matroids, Jones knots, Nash equilibria, Latin transversals, L-membrane FEM, Polya-Vinogradov, dicyclic spectra) share no object/interval/sieve; closest SCOPE-FAIL-018 is F_32 genus-4 Artin-Schreier zeta counting vs Q-arithmetic integral points. Web re-verification of arXiv abstracts failed (transport error, no network), so comparison rests on draft bibliography titles plus training knowledge and is marked as residual risk. No evidence of prior uniform certified integral-point plus height table for this beyond-threshold block was found in cited sources. Draft makes no priority claim over full census. Hence novelty holds; lack of lasting importance is charged to Value, not Originality.

value.rationale: Even though correct and narrowly new, the proved result as stated is not independently worth finding later under SCOPE value gates (textbook restatement / mere parameter substitution / unexplained enumeration). Lane target required Siegel-complete census via David/LLL elliptic-log sieve with rank intervals, saturated generators, Cremona heights/regulators, and global height/Hall witnesses; topic fallback required >=90% Siegel-certified plus explicit bounds/obstructions for remainder. Achieved: 0% Siegel-certified. What remains is: (i) trivial S enumeration by trial division; (ii) torsion triviality which is textbook Fueter/Mazur + square/cube interval check (Lutz divisor check is standard exercise); (iii) exhaustive brute-force table up to arbitrary cutoff B=1e6 (XMIN=-1000) with 23/196 curves nonempty, 173 empty up to B but explicitly possibly nonempty beyond B; Pasten |k|^{1/2+eps} log-bound cited in DRAFT implies true integral points can have x astronomically larger than 1e6, so table is provably a lower-bound fragment, not a census; (iv) rank>=1 trivial corollary of (ii)+(iii); (v) Hall maximizer and naive log heights only among found points (x<=B), not global, with explicit warning not to interpret naive logs as canonical heights — the very canonical-height/regulator artifacts that would make beyond-threshold data citable for rank/regulator/Hall benchmarks (Elkies, D'Mello gaps) are absent. Crossing the 1e7 completeness threshold confers no value without completeness proof: bounded enumeration could be done for any interval, threshold is irrelevant to an incomplete table. Hall max depending on arbitrary B is a property of the search window, not of the curves. Future work needing complete L_k, regulators, or global extrema cannot cite this fragment; it would need to redo the sieve. This is exactly 'unexplained enumeration even if correct and new' and 'mere parameter substitution (next 200 k with arbitrary B)' that the audit brief requires rejecting. No REPAIRABLE fix within presentation exists; completing the sieve/canonical heights is new research, not a fix.
